content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lancaster

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project work. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. You'll attend instructor-led sessions online, on a schedule that fits working professionals in Lancaster's Healthcare, Manufacturing, Financial Services, and Education sectors. This formal coursework satisfies PMI's education requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee when you submit. Granite PM Academy can guide you through the application steps to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit for the PMP.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, work experience, or volunteer service. PMI outlines all paths to renewal; Granite PM Academy can help you plan your PDU strategy early.
